notes.title: Introducing Little Big Adventure – Purple Empire
notes.content:
Dear Twinsider,

The time has come—we’re finally revealing the title of the LBA2 remake: Little Big Adventure – Purple Empire

Like we did with Twinsen’s Quest, we’ve chosen a new title to clearly distinguish the remake from the original. Purple Empire sets the tone for what’s to come: a reimagined journey through Zeelich, full of mystery, absurdity, and cosmic ambition.

What’s new today?

🎮 The Steam page is live and ready to be wishlisted: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2352230/Little_Big_Adventure__Purple_Empire/

🎨 We’re sharing the first concept artwork:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801538/35279c4401938a19dd9d22cac8ea726d3dc7eff9.jpg

Want to support us?


Here’s how you can help bring Purple Empire to life:

💜 Wishlist the game on Steam
📣 Share the news with fellow fans and friends
🎫 Become a member of the Elves Club to follow the dev journey: ko-fi.com/littlebigadventure

So, what do you think of the new title?

Can you guess what “Purple Empire” really refers to?
Drop your thoughts in the comments—we’d love to hear from you.

Thanks for being here,

Ben

notes.title: What’s Next for LBA?
notes.content:
Dear Twinsider,

Since the release of Twinsen’s Quest, one question keeps coming up: Is the LBA2 Remake confirmed?

Before diving into that, let’s take a step back.

After a challenging start, we partnered with Microids in October 2023. The plan was clear: LBA1 Remake, followed by LBA2 Remake, and eventually, LBA3. 

A First Analysis


LBA lives! It wasn’t easy, but we did it—a new LBA game is out on PC and consoles! With 90% positive reviews on Steam and sales progressing as planned, the release has been positive despite the need of a patch.

This game was built in just 15 months on Unity—starting completely fresh after discarding all previous work—by a small but dedicated core team. We made plenty of mistakes—but we made it.

A massive thank you to everyone who worked on the game. Special thanks to the Microids team for making this dream a reality, and to you, the community, for your incredible support.

What’s Next?

Our next priority is understanding what worked well in LBA – Twinsen’s Quest and what we can improve. While we’re thrilled the reviews on Steam, most of you played on consoles—so we need your input!

We also want to know your expectations for the LBA2 Remake.

Finally, as a community, we heard your recurring request to be more engaged on the creation process. More importantly many of you also expressed their desire to have more LBA “perks” with even more special editions this time (think Dinofly Plushes, more skins, your name in the game, etc.).

What about LBA2?

As of today, the game is not yet signed with Microids or any other publisher. We’re exploring all options—including self-publishing. But here’s the exciting news: we’ve already started working on it!

Want to be part of the journey?

I’m looking for 100 community members to have a direct 1-1 conversation with me (in English or French) to help us shape our future. If you’re interested, fill out the form on our official website.

By the way, we’ll be updating the LBA2 Remake Steam page soon (name, screenshot, etc…), but you can already add the game to your wishlist!

Ben
